## Testing

- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests (or an explanation why tests do not apply)
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `python -m ruff check --isolated --select E4,E7,E9,F src tests scripts examples` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/check_public_release.py` passes

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, customer data, sensitive infrastructure details or non-public datasets are included
- [ ] No unsafe new physical-device commands or bypasses of site authorization
- [ ] Public API / installation / docs changes are documented
